init_allscaip_configs: use init_configs with AllScAIPConfigs and a flat kwargs dict to build all nested config dataclasses
create_global_configs: create a GlobalConfigs dataclass to set model hyperparameters like hidden_size, num_layers, and activation function
create_molecular_graph_configs: create a MolecularGraphConfigs dataclass to configure KNN graph construction, max_radius, and distance function settings
create_gnn_configs: create a GraphNeuralNetworksConfigs dataclass to set attention type, num_heads, and expansion sizes for the GNN model
resolve_type_hint: use resolve_type_hint to convert forward reference string type hints into actual class objects for a dataclass field
